findings.sourceToSink: The Web image HEALTHCHECK runs wget --spider against the fixed URL http://127.0.0.1:8080/healthz. deploy/Web.Caddyfile matches /healthz and responds with status 200 without application data.
findings.exploitability: The request originates in the Web container and targets that same container’s loopback interface. The production Compose profile does not publish Web port 8080; it is only exposed to the Compose network. The isolated DAST profile has no published ports and uses an internal network. The probe sends no credentials or application input, and the health route is a static response; an off-container network observer cannot route to or observe this loopback hop.
findings.rootCause: The generic wget rule matches any HTTP URL and does not model the loopback destination or container network namespace.
findings.rationale: CWE-319 requires sensitive information to cross an observable untrusted channel. This fixed liveness check remains on container loopback and transmits no sensitive payload. It is a contextual false positive, not a severity change or a suppressed finding.
evidence: Dockerfile.web:21-22 defines the fixed loopback healthcheck.
deploy/Web.Caddyfile:1-3 defines /healthz as a static status-200 response.
compose.yaml:42-65 exposes Web internally and configures the same loopback healthcheck without a host port mapping.
security/dast/compose.yaml:43-74 has no published ports and attaches Web to the isolated internal network.

findings.sourceToSink: The Caddy service healthcheck uses wget --spider against the fixed URL http://127.0.0.1:2019/config/ from inside the Caddy container to check its local admin endpoint.
findings.exploitability: The destination is 127.0.0.1 in the Caddy container. The production Compose file publishes only 127.0.0.1:80:80 and has no mapping for port 2019. The spider check sends no credentials or application request data and does not download the response body. A remote network observer cannot route to this loopback request.
findings.rootCause: The generic wget rule flags every HTTP URL without modeling the loopback destination, the container boundary, or the absence of a host-published admin port.
findings.rationale: Although the local admin endpoint is queried over HTTP, the health probe is confined to container loopback and sends no sensitive data over an untrusted channel. This is a contextual false positive for CWE-319, not a severity change or a suppressed finding.

deploy/Caddyfile:1-5 shows the configured edge routes and health response; the healthcheck target remains the container-local 127.0.0.1:2019 endpoint.
